id.description: The unique identifier for the project.

parentProjectId.description: The ID of the parent project. If null, this is a top-level project.

contentPermissions.description: The permissions model for the project.

createdAt.description: The date and time the project was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the project was last updated.

topLevelProject.description: Whether this is a top-level project.
